children: That's how much the Congressional Budget Office estimates the energy shock will add to core PCE in the first quarter of 2027 above previous projections.

Closely watched by the Federal Reserve, the inflation gauge excludes volatile food and energy costs. The CBO's updated estimates Tuesday suggest the ripple effects of higher oil prices will extend far beyond Americans' energy bills and into other goods and services.
